Peter McWilliams Released On $250,000 Bail After Month In Federal Jail
Marijuananews.com Visits Los Angeles

Late last night best selling author, AIDS/cancer patient, Peter McWilliams was finally released from federal custody, after a month of abuse and medical neglect.

See

Today he had to report to Pretrial Services as the first part of the continuing harassment to which he will be subjected over the months ahead. He will, of course, have to submit to random "drug" testing.

As soon as he got home last night, McWilliams sent out an email to his friends saying, "I am out, I am home. I am Okay. I am going to bed. Take good care. Enjoy."

I will be interviewing him in the days to come.

I will also have updates from Todd McCormick.
